Bank of Canada reduces policy interest rate

Ottawa, Ontario — 24 July 2026

The Bank of Canada is lowering its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 4.75 per cent.

High frequency data suggest the economy is continuing to expand at a moderate pace. Inflation remains close to the 2 per cent target.

The Bank will continue to assess the evolution of inflation and the economic outlook. The Bank stands ready to adjust policy if needed.
